text: Training to failure may also enhance hypertrophy by increasing metabolic stress. Continuing to train under conditions of anaerobic glycolysis heightens the buildup of metabolites, which theoretically augments post-exercise anabolism. Moreover, the continued compression of vessels induces greater acute hypoxia in the working muscles, which may further contribute to hypertrophic adaptations (222).
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 4: Role of Resistance Training Variables in Hypertrophy
